messages:
Jamie: Hey team — quick heads up, I need to swap out of primary for the 21:00 patch window. There's a small surge of 503s hitting the reranker canary, want to hand off before I go into the maintenance window. @Ashwin can you take primary?
Ashwin: I can take it but quick question — is this the KV cache regen we saw earlier? any lasting customer impact?
Jamie: Yep, looks like some hot prefix cache invalidation cascaded after the canary deploy rolled. Latency spiked to ~1.8s P95 on the reranker, a subset of requests saw 503s for ~3m. No broad customer outage but some internal smoke alerts tripped.
Lina: Do we have logs? can you paste the failing request payload or the svc logs?
Jamie: Pasting truncated logs + the minimal repro:```
[2025-11-02T20:43:12Z] reranker-2 ERROR request_id=abc123 status=503 upstream_err=kv-miss cascade=true
request: {"model":"rerank-v3","prefix_len":128,"batch":1}
```
Jamie: Runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/oncall/kv-cache-regen (see section 'regen-backoff')
Priya: Thanks — if you're swapping out, I can shadow but can't primary due to meetings. Ashwin, do you want a quick ping when I see further 5xx?
Ashwin: Yes please. I'll take primary. Jamie — can you handoff with the usual checklist? quick summary, active incidents, open to-dos, and any temporary mitigations you applied.
Jamie: Copy. Checklist pasted: ```
- Current state: reranker canary saw 503s; latency P50 stable, P95 elevated for 10m window
- Mitigations applied: rolled back canary to rerank-v2, scaled reranker pool +2, disabled aggressive KV invalidation job
- Observability: dashboards: /dash/reranker, alerts: reranker_5xxs_high, kv_miss_rate
- Customer impact: internal smoke alerts only; a tiny percent of end-user sessions affected (confirmed via trace sampling)
- Next steps for on-call: monitor reranker_5xxs_high for 10m, if >2m sustained escalate to infra and pause the cache-regen job permanently
```
Ashwin: Got it. I'm switching my pager to primary now. @SRE Bot can you update rotation to show Ashwin as primary and Jamie as maintenance?
SRE Bot: rotation update queued. Changes: primary -> Ashwin, secondary -> Lina, note: Jamie on maintenance (patch window).
Lina: I'll be secondary. I've got runbook open and can route infra if needed. Any flaky traces to watch for?
Jamie: Watch for: `kv_miss_rate > 0.3` for >2min and `reranker_5xx_rate > 0.05` for >1min. Also watch sequence of `cache_invalidate` jobs in the job queue (last 30m).
Priya: I can keep an eye on customer slack channels and escalate if we see noisy customers. If it turns into a broader outage we follow the incident playbook (pager -> conference -> comms).
Ashwin: Plan: monitor for 15m, if no 5xxs ramp down extra nodes, keep canary rolled back. If 5xxs come back, I'll trigger `jobctl pause cache-regen` and open a Sev2.
Lina: Quick sanity check command if we need it: ```sh
# sample traces for reranker 503s
curl -s 'https://telemetry/api/traces?service=reranker&status=503&since=15m' | jq '.'
```
Ashwin: Thanks. Jamie – anything left for me to know about the rollback sequence you ran? any sticky state?
Jamie: The rollback was clean but the cache job already enqueued some invalidations. I manually bumped the job backoff to 30m and removed 3 pending aggressive invalidations. I left a note in PagerDuty: "removed aggressive invalidations - watch for regen"
Ashwin: Cool. I'll monitor, and ping if I see re-emergence. Good luck with the patch. :thumbsup:
Jamie: Appreciate it — passing primary to Ashwin now. If anything spikes call me on the emergency line, otherwise I'll be in maintenance channel. :wrench:
SRE Bot: rotation change applied at 2025-11-02T20:53:30Z. Primary: Ashwin; Secondary: Lina; Paused: none.
Priya: Thanks all. I'll update the notes in the incident doc if we see any customer mentions.
Ashwin: Taking primary. Starting active watch (15m). Lina, Priya, ping me if you see something odd.
Lina: Standing by.
Jamie: Logging off primary — cheers and thanks for the quick handoff.
